**Note:** Receiver centre wavelength **1450–1620 nm** is a single global receiver table row (not tied to a channel or application); it was not split into per-channel modes. ZR/ZW and recommended data-rate modes use **1528.77 nm** only as the documented **minimum** transmitter centre wavelength from the optical table (not a specific ITU channel). Channel modes omit `standards_code` because the wavelength guide does not pair standards with channels; if every mode must include that field, say so and we can align with your validator rules.
